rows.quote: Colon cancer GWAS data were sourced from the IEU GWAS catalog (UKB-B-20145). <bold>Results</bold> : In this study, we identified onemediating relationship between inflammation, lipid, and colon cancer.
rows.coder_note: Step 2 (rule C4, first case; rule A for case): the accession UKB-B-20145 from the IEU catalog carries the prefix ukb-b, which the MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline row lists (aliases 'ukb-b', 'IEU OpenGWAS ukb-b'); the passage gives no ancestry or counts for this dataset, so nothing conflicts and no other row lists the prefix.
